title: Depth-zero circuits are literals
statement: Let $c$ be a Boolean circuit on $m$ variables whose depth is $0$. Then $c$ is a leaf: there exists a literal $l$ such that $c$ is the single-literal circuit built from $l$.
hypotheses_covered: c is a Boolean circuit on m variables
replaced:
A circuit $c$ with $\mathrm{depth}\,c = 0$ is a literal: there exists $lr : \mathrm{Lit}\,m$
with $c = \mathrm{Circuit.lit}\,lr$.
